updates.background_zh: 1930年《关税法》第338条授权总统对歧视美国商业的国家加征额外进口关税。2026年7月，由于加拿大的附加税令针对美国制造的汽车，第11048号公告对加拿大汽车加征了额外关税。最新公告对相关关税的产品范围作出调整，反映了两国在汽车贸易上的持续摩擦，尽管它们同属《美墨加协定》(USMCA)框架。
updates.background_en: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 allows the President to impose added duties on imports from countries that discriminate against US commerce. In July 2026, Proclamation 11048 applied additional duties to Canadian motor vehicles after Canada's Surtax Order targeted US-built vehicles. This latest proclamation adjusts the product scope of those duties, reflecting continued friction between the two neighbors over automotive trade despite their broader USMCA partnership.
updates.market_impact_zh: 由于该措施仅针对加拿大汽车产品，其对加密货币市场的直接影响有限。任何影响都将通过更广泛的贸易战风险情绪和全球市场风险偏好的变化间接传导。
updates.market_impact_en: Because the measure applies narrowly to Canadian motor-vehicle products, its direct effect on crypto markets is limited. Any impact would come indirectly through changes in broader trade-war risk sentiment and risk appetite across global markets.
